SRC-242:R001.text: Establish how the engine classifies the adopted and attested legacy tickets (SMART T-171/T-181) and validates the committed adoption/attestation carrier; legitimate modern-generation refusal stays, closure checks are never disabled globally

SRC-242:R002.text: A valid committed legacy adoption plus attestation is recognized by repeated recovery without a new approval request; an invalid carrier returns its specific defect instead of being treated as a new allocation

SRC-242:R003.text: status, START, RECOVER, automation.operator_action_due and the response digest agree on whether work can continue; a genuine approval boundary stays explicit on every operator-facing surface

SRC-242:R004.text: Disposable-fixture regression tests: adopted and attested legacy rows stay DONE on repeated recovery; modern unverified DONE still requires its canonical repair; bare LOG text without a committed operation stays insufficient; corrupted, wrong-lineage or stale carriers still refuse; a true unresolved decision yields operator_action_due=true and a matching digest

SRC-242:R005.text: Recovery is idempotent: repeated clean diagnostics write zero STATE/BOARD/LOG bytes, and the partial or interrupted operation path is tested separately from a committed carrier

SRC-242:R006.text: After a verified engine correction the product resumes its original request (SMART SRC-002) through its own canonical START receipt and completes it under its real prerequisites; SRC-003 is the handoff, not the product objective
